claim_ceiling: REPRODUCED: linear_citation_concat provides stable JP improvement (+0.0275 to +0.0392 over best baseline, paired_delta_std 0.016-0.021) across independent seeds. Two-mode tradeoff partially broken (JP only). CiteIndep tradeoff persists. JP < 0.8 factory target. No jurist human validation.
evidence_summary: v13 5-fold CV (seed=42) and v14 independent rerun (seed=137, ML seeds +1000) both confirm linear_citation_concat meets frozen success rule (mean_delta > 0.02, paired_delta_std < 0.03). linear_hybrid05_w3070 fails stability in both (paired_delta_std 0.033 and 0.062). MLP combinations confirmed unstable (paired_delta_std > 0.05). All 16 representations pass adversarial gates. Per-fold refit eliminates pre-training leakage. Sample: 1200 decisions, 5-fold CV. Effect size large (Cohen's d ~1.5). Limitations: JP proxy not jurist-validated, 240 holdout/fold noisy, equal-weight heuristic.
